name: Ankush Bais
summary:

automations and AI solutions, achieving 500+ FTE hours saved, 90%+ error reduction, and sustained business ROI through scalable, governed
platforms.

in solution architecture, GenAI governance, enterprise integrations, and stakeholder engagement, with a demonstrated ability to lead
cross-functional teams and guide organizations from POC to production-scale GenAI and Agentic AI platforms.
